documentation_text: *EHI can be exported in PDF or C-CDA format. Records for a patient are exported to one or more PDF/C-CDA files. The files created by the export are saved to a folder specified by the user.
notes: No data dictionary, schema, or field-level documentation exists. The entire EHI export documentation is a 3-sentence footnote (189 characters) on the vendor's cost disclosure page. No entities or fields can be inventoried because none are documented.
